name: GA-13
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's D+21 partisan lean makes it one of the most Democratic seats in Georgia
Jasmine Clark holds an overwhelming financial edge, with $2.4M raised and $4.2M in outside support versus no reported activity from Jonathan Chavez
Prediction markets price the Democratic nominee near 98 percent
Open seat, but no polling or expert ratings suggest competitiveness
model.rationale: The district's D+21 fundamentals, Clark's massive fundraising and outside-spending advantage, and market pricing near 98 percent all point the same direction, with no polls or ratings indicating a race. An open seat adds some uncertainty, but not nearly enough to threaten the Democratic hold.
model.watch: Any late-breaking scandal or candidate stumble could narrow the margin, though the structural partisan lean makes an outright upset extremely unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Everton Blair (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Georgia's 13th District is among the most Democratic-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of roughly 21 points. Incumbent Everton Blair is not on the ballot for the full term, but the open seat remains firmly in Democratic territory on paper. Jasmine Clark enters the general election with a decisive financial edge, having raised about $2.4 million and drawn more than $4 million in outside support, while Republican Jonathan Chavez shows little measurable fundraising activity.

Prediction markets price the Democratic nominee's chances near 98 percent, and no public polls or expert ratings point to a competitive race. The district's fundamentals, combined with the stark resource imbalance between the candidates, make a Republican upset highly unlikely. The forecast places this race firmly in the Safe Democratic category, with the main question being the size of the winning margin rather than the winner's identity.
